title: Boba Fett Briefs His Crew on the Pyke Threat
description: As Boba Fett vies for control of the soul of Mos Espa as the daimyo in charge, he has assembled his allies to brief them on the threat presented by the dangerous Pyke Syndicate. Between the Modifiers, Fennec Shand, Krrsantan, the Mandalorian, and the people of Freetown, Fett might have assembled enough muscle to force the Pykes from plying their trade in Mos Espa and, perhaps, all of Tatooine. But his position is, at best, tenuous. Boba Fett wanted to take over Jabba the Hutt's enterprise, and now he's engaged in the fight of his life for it.
